scientific_integrity: General all-parameter statement is proved by characteristic-two local algebra. Finite GF2 computations are independent corroboration, not infinite certificates. Historical related results and a distinct binary-field Lights Out operator are explicitly distinguished.
scientific_limitations: The exact primitive-period census inside the invertible component is not established. The work applies only to simple P(n,2), n>=5, synchronous open-neighbour XOR over F2. Novelty remains conditional on the cited literature coverage; an obscure equivalent cannot be excluded.
title: Three–five resonance and exact extinction-depth census for binary parity on generalized Petersen graphs
